'''Tiplar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
[[File:Tiplee_and_Tiplar.png|thumb|left|300px|Tiplar fought side by side with her sister, Tiplee, at Ringo Vinda.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 52: Ringo Vinda" /> Tiplar was teamed-up with her sister, [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], and their fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|conquer]] a Separatist [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in-orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]]. During the subsequent battle, she noticed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] approaching her and (assuming that he was coming to reinforce her) was stunned when he pointed his blaster at her and shot her at point-blank range, killing her instantly. Her sister, Tiplee, witnessed this and immediately ran to Tiplar, who was already dead. Following her slaying, Skywalker sent Tup back to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where the clone troopers were created, to find the reasons behind his apparent malfunction.<ref name="TCW601" />

The circumstances of Tiplar's murder were revealed to be a conspiracy by the Supreme Chancellor himself, to use the clone troopers in a plot to murder the Jedi, a directive which was programmed into them via an inhibitor chip in their brains. Tup's chip malfunctioned, causing him to murder Tiplar preemptively. Fellow trooper [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] attempted to prove this, but thanks to the Chancellor's manipulations, the secret died with him.

==Equipment==
When engaged in combat, Tiplar wielded a green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TCW601" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiplar's design, alongside that of her sister Tiplee, was based on concept art for a female Sith that was cut from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="The Unknown trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
